content.what_it_is: MATLAB sediment-rip snapshot postprocessor. It loads baseline dep.out and builds a dx=1,dy=2 grid (L8-L25), fixes the frame range to index 5 (L32-L40), loads velocity/elevation/mask, concentration C_, and evolving dep_, then computes depth change (L45-L60). It plots eta, log10 concentration with velocity arrows, and depth change in three panels (L62-L114).
unresolved: Masking is applied to eta, baseline dep, u, and v at L57-L60, but not to concentration `ch` or depth change `depp`, which was computed before masking at L52-L54. Thus the second and third panels can display dry-cell/sentinel values while the first panel and arrows hide them—an inconsistent mask interface.
`log10(ch)` at L82 has no positive-value check; zero concentration yields -Inf and negative/sentinel values yield complex results, yet the finite caxis [-1,1] at L83 assumes valid logarithms.

Baseline `dep` is destructively masked inside the loop at L58; the current single-frame range hides accumulation, but any multi-frame range would retain earlier dry-mask NaNs and also compute later depp at L54 against an already-corrupted baseline.
Fixed ax=[0,249,0,199] is not derived from n,m,dx,dy, and no cross-array shape check precedes arithmetic/masking.
